messages.author: 71171f0d61fc140f
messages.subject: A plyr and reshape workshop
parts:
Hi all,

For the last 4 weeks, I've been running a workshop on data management
and manipulation in R. I've focused very heavily on the use of plyr
and reshape, which is why I figure this would be a good forum for
comments and suggestions.

Here is a link to the main index:
http://www.ling.upenn.edu/~joseff/rstudy/index.html#summer2010

The topics are as follows:
--General: Data Structure
General, domain general discussion about principles of data
collection, storage, and organization.

--R: Basics
Some basics about the R language

--R: Summarization and Aggregation
Approaches for summarizing and aggregating data in R. I discuss the
base functions table() and tapply(), but the rest of the discussion
focuses exclusively on using plyr.

--R: Functions
Some basics (really basic basics) on writing R functions

--R: Reshaping
Using the reshape package to reorganize data into more useful formats.

If anyone here has comments on the contents, or suggested revisions,
please pass them along!

-Joe
